run_profiling_all_fingers: run cProfile on trifingerone, trifingeredu, and trifingerpro with and without visualization enabled
execute_random_motion: create a SimFinger instance and apply random torque actions over a specified number of timesteps
profile_finger_with_visualization: profile a specific TriFinger variant with visualization enabled to measure rendering overhead
profile_finger_without_visualization: profile a specific TriFinger variant with visualization disabled to measure pure simulation performance
print_profile_stats: load cProfile stats files and print the top 3 functions sorted by total time
